_comment: §C substitution/echo: activates subject.raEchoMethod (GENERAL echo PIP). The echo rule returns the received request; response.extract=$.method binds 'POST'. Allow proves the PIP resolved; the test also asserts via GET /pip-stub/calls that the substituted query/headers/body reached the stub.
§C whole-value array for IN: subject.raAllowedIds = [C1,C2,C3] from $.data.ids[*].id. resource.id IN that set.
§E timeout-uses-default: subject.raSlowIds times out (timeoutSeconds:1 vs delayMs:3000) and resolves to defaultValue [TIMEOUT-DEFAULT]; resource.id IN that default set.

§D negation fail-closed + OR isolation: subject.raBrokenId is a hard-failing GENERAL PIP (500, onMissing:error -> alias ABSENT). The negation operand `subject.raBrokenId != 'sentinel'` must NOT grant on the failure; the rule allows ONLY via the OR sibling resource.ok == true. resource.ok:false must deny (branch genuinely false, not fail-open).
